title: Structural Identifiability in Non-Gaussian Graphical Discrete Lyapunov Models
summary: This paper studies the problem of structural identifiability for graphical discrete Lyapunov models in the non-Gaussian setting from observational data. A graphical discrete Lyapunov model associated with a graph $G$ consists of the set of stationary distributions of stable first-order vector autoregressive models whose transition matrices have sparsity patterns determined by $G$. This model has a causal interpretation as $G$ can be viewed as encoding dynamic causal relationships between random variables of interest.
